❯ Write about 300 words on why terminal multiplexers are useful.
  Second line, plain words: Enter and C-c.

● Terminal multiplexers like tmux and screen solve a problem every developer runs into: a single terminal window can only show one shell at a time, but real
  work rarely happens in just one context. A multiplexer lets you split a terminal into multiple panes and windows, each running its own shell, so you can watch
